data.title: Use the physical board microphone as the voice input instead of the Mac mic

evidence: User: "Leo fixed the mic - so that will be pushed and we should use the mic on the device and not the mac". Agent added --mic board default and waits for Leo's firmware push and board connection.

data.text: The Atech board microphone is the default voice input for the local demo. The Mac microphone is only a fallback (voice_station --mic mac).
data.rationale: User explicitly reverses the earlier Mac-mic decision: use the mic on the device, not the Mac, once Leo's mic fix is pushed.
